text_block_list.name: Lost Woman
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! I heard there's a carrot bread
shop around here. Do you happen to know where it is?

text_block_list.name: Lost Woman
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Even just the name of the shop would be great.
That way I can look it up myself!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um... well...
T-The bakery was, if I recall...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(......H-Huh? Why can't I remember it!?
I should know both the place and the name...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, uh, umm... I-I'm sorry! I-I don't... understand...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(...Ugh. If only I weren't like this...
I'm so sorry, Miss...)
